'''2000 Kashyyyk Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Kashyyyk region (Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, Vermont) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00kashyyyk">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=kashyyyk 2000 Regionals: Kashyyyk], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727141158/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=kashyyyk Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Steve Brentson]] of Ledyard, Connecticut won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 22 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Boxborugh Holiday Inn - EXHIBIT HALL! 1 Adams Place Boxborough, Massachusetts
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Kris Earle]]
* '''Players:''' 63<ref name="tr-d1066" />

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Kashyyyk Regionals Eric Hunter kashyyyk reg 2nd ls]] ([[Eric Hunter]], [[Light]]; 2nd)
* [[2000 Kashyyyk Regionals Steve Baroni Local Uprising With a Big Twist]] ([[Steve Baroni]], [[Light]]; 2–1) — "went 2-1 Loosing only to Steve Brentsons deck"
* [[2000 Kashyyyk Regionals Steve Baroni Bring Him The Sevens]] ([[Steve Baroni]], [[Dark]]) — "only lost one game during the Kashhyyk Regionals"
